summary: Monthly review with Sofía Medina (Casa Verde Hotels). Direct bookings rose 14% month on month, led by Tulum. The October report wrongly listed Oaxaca as a separate brand, and Sofía's director noticed. Casa Verde opens Valle de Bravo in March and wants a launch plan. A new head of marketing, Carla Ruiz, starts on 10 November and will review all agencies in her first month.

tasks.title: Resend October report with Oaxaca under Casa Verde Hotels

tasks.evidence: Priya, can you fix the October report so Oaxaca sits under Casa Verde, and resend it? / Yes, I'll have the revised version out tomorrow.

tasks.title: Send Valle de Bravo launch plan outline to Casa Verde Hotels
tasks.description: First outline with channels and a rough budget for the March opening.
tasks.evidence: I'll put together a first outline with channels and a rough budget. Would two weeks work? / Two weeks is fine.

tasks.title: Chase approval of December holiday creatives with Casa Verde

tasks.evidence: Legal has them. I'll push, but I can't promise before next week.
